standard_prerequisites.name: Equivalence of precategories
standard_prerequisites.statement: F is an equivalence of precategories when there is a functor G with natural isomorphisms G F = 1 and F G = 1.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the first of the two equivalent types.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fully faithful functor
standard_prerequisites.statement: F is fully faithful when each map hom_A(a,b) -> hom_B(Fa,Fb) is an equivalence.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is one half of the second type and is used to build the candidate inverse functor.

standard_prerequisites.name: Split essentially surjective functor
standard_prerequisites.statement: F is split essentially surjective when for every b : B there is a specified a : A with Fa = b.
standard_prerequisites.use: It supplies the object map of the candidate inverse without using truncation.

core_obligations: From an equivalence of precategories with inverse G and natural isomorphisms eta, epsilon, build the inverse map hom_B(Fa,Fb) -> hom_A(a,b) and show the action on hom-sets is an equivalence, using the components of eta and epsilon (source lines 596-620).
Show that F is split essentially surjective by reading a preimage of b off from the functor G, using that eta provides an isomorphism between b and the object chosen by G (source lines 620-630).

Conversely, given F fully faithful and split essentially surjective, define a functor G on objects by the specified preimages and on morphisms by transporting along the hom-set equivalences supplied by full faithfulness (source lines 630-637).

Verify that the two composites are naturally isomorphic to the identities, using the coherence data produced by the split essential surjectivity and the fact that the hom-set maps are equivalences (source lines 630-637).

proof_roadmap.step: From an equivalence build the hom-set inverse and prove it is an equivalence.
Extract split essential surjectivity from the inverse functor.
Conversely build the inverse functor and the two natural isomorphisms.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.4.5 at source lines 588-594: for precategories A and B and a functor F : A -> B, being an equivalence of precategories is equivalent to being fully faithful and split essentially surjective. The author's proof (source lines 595-637) runs in both directions and neither is a citation. In the forward direction the inverse functor G together with the natural isomorphisms eta and epsilon is used to build an explicit inverse to the action of F on hom-sets and to verify the two inverse identities (lines 596-620), and split essential surjectivity is then read off from G using the component of eta at b (lines 620-630). In the converse, the object map of the inverse is given by the specified preimages and the morphism map must be manufactured by transporting along the hom-set equivalences that full faithfulness provides, after which both composite natural isomorphisms have to be checked (lines 630-637). The statement displays only the two equivalent types.
